name: UDAAN
target_group: Girls studying in eligible school classes and preparing for engineering entrance pathways, subject to programme rules
eligibility: Eligibility is governed by the current UDAAN programme criteria and selection process.
benefits: Academic support, learning resources and mentoring intended to help girls prepare for engineering entrance examinations.
application_process: Apply through the official CBSE UDAAN programme when applications are invited.
source: Central Board of Secondary Education / Government of India
